title: Active to Passive Voice: First Practice — Quiz 102
content:
## Active to Passive Voice: First Practice

Change four statements into passive voice.

### Lesson focus

1. Negligence causes many serious accidents.
2. The students are decorating the hall.
3. God has helped me.
4. Most people opposed this.

### Understand the pattern

First identify the object of the active sentence. Make it the new subject, keep the time reference, and select the matching passive auxiliary. A continuous form needs being; a perfect form needs been. The main verb becomes a past participle.

### Worked answers and explanation

1. Many serious accidents are caused by negligence.
2. The hall is being decorated by the students.
3. I have been helped by God.
4. This was opposed by most people.

Notice are caused, is being decorated, have been helped and was opposed: the auxiliaries preserve four different tense/aspect patterns.

### Try another

Change: The students have completed the display.

### Suggested answer

The display has been completed by the students. The new singular subject display takes has, even though students took have in the active sentence.
